text:
maria: Rolling svc-inference v3.4.1 in ~10m. Primary watcher is me but need someone on metrics (datadog) + someone standing by for rollback. Quick smoke checklist in-thread.

samir: I can watch metrics for the first 30m post-rollout. Will keep an eye on p95 and error-rate dashboards. Ping me when rollout starts.

nik: I'll be on-call for rollback readiness. If anything crosses the thresholds below I can trigger undo.

maria: Top-level smoke items: 1) smoke script (local) 2) p95 latency <= 220ms 3) error-rate <= 0.5% 4) KV cache hit >= 80% 5) ingest QPS within 10% of baseline. Run this: ```./scripts/smoke.sh --env=prod --sample=50```

dev-bot: deploy-schedule: svc-inference v3.4.1 -> rolling update across west/central/eu starting at 1772143600, expected 12m. Canary 10%.

raul: linking runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/deploy-smoke. For rollback: `kubectl rollout undo deploy/svc-inference --to-revision=3` — keep the revision # handy.

samir: Observability quick checks I'll watch: `inference.p95`, `inference.errors.rate`, `cache.kv.hit_rate`. Will create a temporary dashboard and post link when ready.

nik: Thresholds to act: if p95 > 350ms for 3 consecutive minutes OR error-rate > 1.0% OR cache hit drops > 20% vs baseline. If any triggered, I'll start rollback and notify infra.

maria: FYI small post-deploy hotfix (if needed) is at PR #4723 — it's a minor header propagation fix that we can canary separately. If rollback happens we keep the PR blocked until we confirm root cause.

ops-bot: NOTE: remember to disable scheduled heavy jobs on inference-db for the next 20m.

samir: dashboard link: https://datadog.com/dash/xyz/inference-smoke (temp) - I set alerts for p95 > 300ms and errors > 0.8% (warn) / 1.2% (critical).

maria: starting rollout now. tagging this thread. I'll post status updates every 3m.

dev-bot: rollout started for svc-inference v3.4.1 at 1772143618. Canary nodes replaced (10%).

maria: Canary looks good after 3m: p95=200ms, errors=0.1%, cache hit=84%. Proceeding with zone 2.

samir: zone 2 steady. p95=215ms, errors=0.15%. No spikes in CPU or OOM.

raul: quick note: if we see increased kv latency it might be the new cache warm-up behaviour; watch the `kv.latency` metric.

maria: Full rollout complete. Final checks: p95=210ms, error-rate=0.12%, kv hit=82%, QPS -4% (expected). Marking this as success unless someone objects in next 10m.

nik: Looks clean from my side. No rollback. I'll keep on-call for another 20m.

samir: I've archived the temp dashboard and set a 1h retention snapshot. Will follow up with a short post-deploy note in release notes channel.

maria: Thanks everyone. If anything unexpected shows up file a ticket and ping this thread. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Reminder: re-enable scheduled heavy jobs in 18m.
